phase: Composition, not volume. Over 192 no-policy cells v25 bought 71 items, 46 of them the same forced online detergent, and seven of the eleven categories in the citizens' own profile were never bought. v31 re-aims the profile guard.
primary: Total-variation distance between what was bought and the citizen's own assigned category mix, off arm, pooled over four seeds. Shares only, so a candidate cannot win by buying more of the same thing - which is exactly how v30 won v7 and then made two answer-key indicators significantly wrong.
limitations: The target is the citizens' own assigned mix, never an answer key. Naming a sector the studies measure would be steering.
Distance falling is not the same as the policy indicators improving; the indicators are checked separately and can still fail.
Twelve people, four seeds. Precision for these twelve.
The forced detergent purchase is a scenario artifact; a candidate that only removes it would lower the distance without being better at consumption.
preflight: 277 unit checks passed including 6 new resource-gate regressions. Source, v25 and asset_transaction_v7 unchanged from the previous round.
selection: Closed pair fixed before the run (experiments/v8/prompt_v8.md). v31 differs from v25 by one clause; enforced by test_profile_guard_reaim.py.
